name: Pure Song Garden!
original_name: ピュアソングガーデン！
source:
In 2027, advances in virtual reality technology have allowed for the creation of a ‘mixed reality’, combining both reality and virtual reality. It is not uncommon to see ‘virtual idols’ performing, and the most popular one is Ai, who was created using the newest state-of-the-art VR technology. Kanata is part of the M3 (Music Mediaworks Mate) circle of music lovers, along with his self-proclaimed guardian and cohabitant Kuon, and kouhai Asuka, who is interested only in weird ‘sounds’, among others.

One day, they were able to attend the huge virtual live event “Pure Song Garden” as part-time staff members thanks to the connections of Ritsu, a lady who lives in the same apartment as Kanata, and who used to take care of him when he was a child. Before the event, Ritsu brought them to the stage and did a start-up test for Ai as a special demo for them, but when she appeared, something felt off.

Actually, it was not Ai, but a beautiful girl Iroha who looked just like her. She said that she came from fifty years in the future for a short trip. Her ‘navigator fairy’ Suzu, a girl with fairy-like wings who accompanied her, explained that only Iroha’s consciousness travelled from the future and that she was only temporarily using Ai’s virtual body. At that time, there was a great commotion on the event grounds over Ai’s sudden disappearance. Iroha will have to take over Ai’s role on stage at the live, and Ritsu and the M3 members did their best to support her.

Everything was going smoothly at “Ai”‘s performance when a warning sounded and an unexpected error occurred! The “VR hazard” accident resulted in Iroha unable to return to the future.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/06/01/june-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
2027年，虚拟现实技术的进步，使现实与虚拟现实相结合的“混合现实”得以实现。“虚拟偶像”的演出已不鲜见，其中人气最高的是采用最先进VR技术打造的Ai。奏多是音乐爱好者社团M3（Music Mediaworks Mate）的成员。同社团的还有与他同住、自称他的监护人的玖音，以及只对奇怪“声音”感兴趣的学妹明日歌等人。

一天，凭借律的人脉，他们得以兼职工作人员的身份参加大型虚拟演唱会“Pure Song Garden”。律与奏多住在同一栋公寓，曾在他小时候照顾过他。活动开始前，律带他们来到舞台，为他们特别演示Ai的启动测试。然而，Ai出现时，似乎有些不对劲。

原来，出现的并非Ai，而是与她长得一模一样的美丽少女Iroha。她说自己来自五十年后的未来，只是来短途旅行。同行的“导航妖精”Suzu是一位长着妖精般翅膀的女孩。她解释道，穿越到此的只有Iroha的意识，她只是暂时借用了Ai的虚拟身体。此时，活动现场因Ai突然失踪而陷入混乱。Iroha必须顶替Ai登台演出，律与M3成员们也尽力支持她。

“Ai”的演出原本一切顺利，却突然响起警报，发生了意料之外的错误！这起“VR灾害”事故，令Iroha无法返回未来。

[来源：[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/06/01/june-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
